verdict.rationale: The only multi-item capability in the evidence is rule-based automation: auto-transfers that split each deposit from one account to multiple accounts by dollar amount or percentage, across up to 20 checking accounts. That is distribution logic, not general bulk operations, and a community user notes external payments still have to be executed manually. Missing for 10: batch or bulk payment execution, bulk editing or categorization of transactions, bulk card issuance or management actions, API or AI-driven bulk tooling, and independent hands-on corroboration.
